Solvecha joins the captcha accounts, and the Android app's background notice no longer pops up again and again.

## ✨ Added

- **Solvecha as a seventh captcha account.** It reads picture captchas only, so reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile and click captchas go on to the next account in the order. It is tried only once its key is saved on the Accounts page, which shows its logo next to the other services. Thanks to @userlip for adding it. ([#133](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/pull/133))

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The Android app's background notice stays put.** With Stay connected on, the app posted its "No downloads running" notice again on every look at the server, and some phones popped it up each time. It is posted again only when its words change.
